quotes.by: agent (recommended; the arbiter decided it as overview-health-cached-background)
quotes.text: Web-side background cache: the daemon's web server computes health in the background, single-flight, pages render the last result and never wait for it; before the first result the panel shows health as checking.

fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the slow Overview page (/ and /fragments/daemon about 5 s, because WebDaemonSource runs the full health report with rhiza check on every render). The daemon keeps no health result to reuse today. One question was raised: how the Overview gets health without running it per request. The arbiter decided on an in-memory health report in WebDaemonSource, refreshed in the background (single flight, about 30 s staleness), pills shown as pending before the first report, daemon status read live, no change to the daemon poll or its state file. Planned one leaf under web-monitor, serving m28-browser-monitor. Nothing left open.
fields.title: Fast web UI Overview, autonomous plan
